lines.zh: 我摆尾碾过海底的淤泥
lines.en: I sweep my tail through the seabed silt.

lines.zh: 泥盆纪的海床归我巡视
lines.en: The Devonian seafloor is mine to patrol.
I glide slowly along the reef.
Water pressure hums against my bony plates.

lines.zh: 我顺着暗流找猎物的味道
lines.en: I follow the current toward a scent.

lines.zh: 这副身板生来就该巡海
lines.en: This body was built to roam the sea.

lines.zh: 前方三丈,我记得有鱼群
lines.en: Three lengths ahead, I recall a school.
I need no speed; catching up is enough.
My armour grinds with a dull sound.
I cruise past the edge of the trench.
The kelp cannot hold my fins.

lines.zh: 我在冷水层里保持节奏
lines.en: I keep my pace in the cold layer.
One tailbeat carries me half a length.
I push toward darker water.
Silt billows up behind me.

lines.zh: 我的下颌已经微微张开
lines.en: My jaw already hangs slightly open.
I round the wreck of a sunken ship.

lines.zh: 这条海沟没有第二个霸主
lines.en: No second ruler swims this trench.
I hang in the water, utterly still.

lines.zh: 我在等水流把气味送来
lines.en: I wait for the current to bring a scent.
I watch the shifting light above.
My teeth wait behind the jaw plates.
I slowly swallow a mouthful of seawater.
Quiet; a hunter need not make noise.
I let the current sway my body.
My gill covers open and close, never resting.
I rest a while in the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 这片海域暂时没有动静
lines.en: Nothing stirs in this stretch of sea.
I flex my jaw muscles, then release.
Prey always makes the first mistake.
I count the fish passing overhead.

lines.zh: 耐心是我最锋利的部分
lines.en: Patience is my sharpest part.
You tread water far too loudly.
What a large piece of moving meat.
I turn and face you squarely.
You float above my sea.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上陆地的味道
lines.en: I smell land on you.
Do not put your hand in the water.
I lift my head to study that shape.
Smaller than a shark, but louder.
My jaw plates are already aimed at you.
You hesitate; I calculate.

lines.zh: 我绕你的影子转了半圈
lines.en: I circle half around your shadow.
Only a layer of water lies between us.
One blink of yours, and I am closer.

lines.zh: 浮上来换气的都不聪明
lines.en: Anything that surfaces to breathe is unwise.
Pain? This is nothing yet.
A crack runs through my armour.
You dared touch my skull.
The water is churned; I dislike it.
I sweep my tail to steady myself.
This wound will remember you.
I let out one low cry.
You picked the wrong prey.
The pain only makes me hungrier.
Back off; I need a moment.
A smell of blood leaks down from the surface.
That scent makes me forget my patrol.
I come closer, just a little closer.
That is the smell of raw meat.
My jaw opens on its own.

lines.zh: 你手里那团东西在滴血
lines.en: That thing in your hand drips blood.
I circle around the scent.

lines.zh: 它比礁石间的鱼更诱人
lines.en: It tempts me more than any reef fish.
I am not picky, only greedy for size.
Lower it just a little more.
My tail speeds up against my will.
Hunger presses my caution down.
I want that bite, and I want it now.
The taste is spreading through the water.
You struck my bony armour.
I do not budge; you recoil.
Hard against hard, and you lose.
My skull is harder than your hull.

lines.zh: 别用身体试探我的重量
lines.en: Do not test my weight with your body.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起,水都浑了
lines.en: We collide, and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 这一下你不该靠这么近
lines.en: You should not have come that close.
I am shoved half a foot off course.
My side fin sweeps across your calf.
Back off; this channel is mine.
Between our kind, words are unnecessary.

lines.zh: 两副骨甲并排，推开泥浪。
lines.en: Two bony armors side by side push through the mud.
My fin touches yours.
This stretch of water is quiet enough.
Together we stir up the mud.
You circle me, and I circle back.
Devonian custom: judge by the jaws.
We share this hunting ground.
Slowly; the water will not rush us.
With you here, patrol is less dull.

lines.zh: 我叼住那块沉下来的东西
lines.en: I catch that thing sinking past me.
This pile of bones belongs to me.
I tuck it under my tongue and carry it off.
I keep whatever the wreck lets fall.
This iron tastes bitter in the water.
I bite down and will not let go.
Something has fallen into my trench.
I drag the prize back to my nest.
It is mine; nobody else may take it.
This one is heavier than the last.
I have you; do not move.
Scent, shadow, heartbeat: all confirmed.
You are today's main course.
My pupils narrow once.
You, then. Do not think of running.
I adjust my heading straight at you.
The prey's outline is clear now.
Target chosen; I will not change it.
The water tells me where you are.
I have planned this bite for a while.
You go left; I go left.
I match the rhythm of your strokes.
The gap narrows, bit by bit.
I am in no hurry; you will tire.
My jaw bones can snap bone.
I close in each time you surface.
My shadow stays beneath you.
This wake points straight at you.
You loop around; so do I.
I hold two lengths, enough to lunge.
The jaw plates snap shut.
This bite can shatter shell.
I drag you under.
The bony blade sinks in without effort.
Even a shark cannot take this bite.
I whip my head and tear you open.
Blood blooms into a cloud.
Do not struggle; it only sinks deeper.
My jaw crushes through bone.
This blow comes from the Devonian.

lines.zh: 泥盆纪的海水灌进来了
lines.en: Devonian seawater floods in.

lines.zh: 我从深渊的淤泥里升起
lines.en: I rise from the silt of the deep.
My armour breaks the surface first.
Four hundred million years of hunger wakes.
This sea has a master again.
My shadow swallows the reef.
The old sovereign returns to the water.

lines.zh: 你听见水底那声闷响了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that thud from below?

lines.zh: 我从海沟的裂缝里挤出来
lines.en: I squeeze out of a fissure in the trench.
The mud settles; I open my eyes.
I am back, and I brought my teeth.
The sea parts to make me a path.
The water boils hot; my armour burns.
I slam down hard into the mud.
I was born to water, yet I choke.
The blast flips me; my insides ache.
Something has lodged in my side fin.

lines.zh: 那道光在我骨头里嗡嗡响
lines.en: That light buzzes inside my bones.
Empty-bellied, even my teeth feel soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面,我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea; I am numb.
There is no water here; I am coming apart.
